meta_description: Midlands Locksmith & Security Systems in Leicester. Emergency lockouts, lock repairs, and security installations. Fast response, trusted local service.
hero_subhead: We'll get you back inside in under an hour. Call now for emergency locksmith help, any time of day or night.
services_subhead: From emergency lockouts to complete security system installations, we handle residential and commercial lock and key work.

services.title: Emergency Lockout Response
services.desc: Locked out of your home or car? We arrive armed with professional tools and can open most locks without damage. Available 24/7, any day of the week.

services.title: Lock Repair & Replacement
services.desc: Worn locks, damaged mechanisms, or broken keys. We repair or replace locks on doors, windows, and safes, using quality hardware that lasts.

services.title: Cylinder & Mortice Lock Services
services.desc: Expert fitting of euro cylinders, mortice locks, and high-security variants. Perfect for improving home security or replacing worn units.

services.title: UPVC Door & Window Locks
services.desc: Specialise in UPVC door and window lock repairs and upgrades. Broken handles, seized locks, and adjustments all handled quickly and affordably.

services.title: Security Systems Installation
services.desc: Professional installation of door and window alarms, CCTV systems, and access control for homes and small businesses. Full aftercare support included.

services.title: Master Key Systems
services.desc: Bespoke keying solutions for landlords and businesses. Simplify access management while maintaining security across multiple properties.

about_pullquote: I built this business helping locals get back inside without paying rip-off rates.
about_para_1: Midlands Locksmith & Security Systems has been serving Leicester residents and businesses for 18 years. Started as a sole trader responding to neighbours' lockouts, we've grown into a trusted emergency service covering the whole city. Every locksmith on our team is fully trained and insured, and we carry professional tools that allow us to open nearly every type of lock without forcing or damaging your door.
about_para_2: We're known locally for honesty: no inflated call charges, no unnecessary upsells, and a fair price every time. Repeat customers keep coming back because they know we'll show up quickly, fix the problem properly, and treat their home with respect. Whether it's a midnight lockout or a security upgrade for a new property, we approach every job with the same care.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had my keys nicked from the pub and was standing outside in the freezing cold at 11pm. Called Midlands Locksmith and a bloke was round within 45 minutes. Opened the door without any damage and charged a fair rate. Lifesaver of the night.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Brilliant service. Our UPVC door lock had jammed and we thought we'd be spending hundreds on a replacement door. The locksmith came, identified the problem in the mechanism, and sorted it for £85. Very professional and friendly. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Rachel M.

reviews.text: Fitted new security locks on our rental property and installed a basic alarm system. Really competitive quote, finished ahead of schedule, and the tenants say everything works perfectly. Will use again for our next property.
reviews.author: David H.
